items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: You should have heard him, Nick and Bronnie, do the three.

ctx.x: You don't have to rush time. You have to wait for this one, don't you?

So I said, mail them right here. Guess what I told you, the mailers call here. You know, around the county they have the mailbox and your dirt can. Look just like the mailbox. I said, mail them, he put all them cards. So the trash man had come around and pick up and all these letters fell out the way he put them, you know. I got to the mailers to this hotel. Somebody mail their cars in the trash can and I left the hotel right away. They didn't see me until Louis didn't see me, because I stayed at the New Styler…
